_comment: Per-year official UPSC source URLs for Civil Services (Main) question papers.
Used by scripts/backfill_pyq_paper_provenance.py to satisfy the provenance
gate on POST /pyq-papers/{id}/review (pending -> verified requires a
verified=true means the URL was confirmed to exist as an indexed page on
upsc.gov.in. verified=false means it follows the same URL pattern but was
NOT confirmed — open it in a browser, correct it if it 404s, and flip the
flag before using it as provenance. The backfill script refuses to write
an unverified URL unless --allow-unverified is passed.
One paper row per year holds GS1-4 + Essay, so the anchor is the year's
exam page (which lists all five PDFs) rather than a single PDF.

2013.note: Older years use the question-papers-year-YYYY archive scheme.

2014.note: Uses the examinations scheme despite being an early year.

2015.note: Only the year-archive scheme was confirmed for 2015.
